description: Source code for the NoteService class in a Java Spring backend project. It provides CRUD operations for notes, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, with associated exception handling and mapping logic.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service class for managing notes, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting note entities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note from the specified request data.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: listByUser
methods.description: Lists all notes for a given user ordered by last update time descending.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note's title/content after validating ownership.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID if it belongs to the specified user.
